who: Ingald Belger, the Apothecary, brews potions in his shop in south-west Varrock and will mix almost anything for anyone who brings the ingredients. Dry and businesslike, he gives out gossip more freely than charity, and has made everything from a sleep that looks like death to a sailors' cure that is mostly vodka.
